questions.question: Define the term 'foreign direct investment'. (2 marks)

An economy exports $66.0bn and imports $54.0bn in a year when its GDP is $150.0bn. Ten years earlier the same figures were $20.0bn, $16.0bn and $72.0bn. Calculate trade as a proportion of GDP in each year, and the change between them. (4 marks)
Explain one factor that has contributed to increased globalisation in the last fifty years. (4 marks)
Analyse the impact of foreign direct investment by a transnational company on a developing economy that receives it. (6 marks)
A country's demand for a device is 100,000 units at $150 and 260,000 units at $70, and demand is linear. Draw a diagram showing the consumer surplus at each price and label the gain. (4 marks)
Examine the benefits of globalisation for consumers in a small open economy. (8 marks)
Discuss the costs of globalisation for an economy that has recently opened to trade and foreign investment. (14 marks)
Evaluate the view that the benefits of globalisation for a developing economy outweigh the costs. (20 marks)

leaves.wording: Increase in trade as a proportion of GDP.
Increase in importance of transnational companies (TNCs) and foreign direct investment (FDI).
